channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained as Florida Forest Service warns of more to come this summer
item.description: Two brush fires broke out in Martin County this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike. Both fires are now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service, which says the conditions that fuel these fires are not going away anytime soon but residents should not be alarmed

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked 67th most stressed city in the US, cited as 42nd most financially stressed
item.description: A new WalletHub study ranked Port St. Lucie as the 67th most stressed city in the United States, with the report citing the city as the 42nd most financially stressed in America.

item.title: Karolina Muchova ends Coco Gauff's Wimbledon run in dramatic tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday to become the fourth Czech woman in six years to reach the final.

item.title: Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon after recovering from five blown match points
item.description: Czech player Linda Noskova recovered from a second-set meltdown to beat Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in an all-Czech final on Saturday for her first Grand Slam trophy.

item.title: St. Lucie Mets Snap Three-Game Skid With 4-1 Win Over Jupiter
item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets snapped a three-game losing streak Saturday evening with a wire-to-wire 4-1 win over the Jupiter Hammerheads at Roger Dean Chevrolet Stadium.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with panoramic ocean views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
